Software Development [Mobile App]

Facial Recognition Attendance App

Lead Developer

Records student attendance with a face scan. Each student looks at the camera and the app logs the time.

How it works. Students register with one clear photo. At the door, the camera captures a live face. The app compares it with saved profiles. A match marks the student present with a timestamp. Teachers view the attendance list.

Why it matters. Paper sheets allow proxy signing and cost class time. A face scan confirms who is present, takes seconds, and keeps an accurate record.

Tech stack
PythonOpenCVFace RecognitionSQLite

Software Development [Web System]

School Clinic Medicine Request System

Full Stack Developer

Lets students request medicine online instead of waiting in line at the clinic.

How it works. A student selects a medicine, enters the quantity, and states the purpose. Clinic staff review the request and track it in real time. The student receives a notification when the medicine is ready. Staff manage inventory and reports in one dashboard.

Why it matters. Requests stay organized and records stay secure. Staff see stock levels and respond faster. Students spend less time waiting.

Tech stack
HTMLCSSJavaScriptPHPMySQL

Software Development [Web System]

Campus Lost and Found System

Systems Analyst and Developer

Helps students report lost items and find them again.

How it works. Finders post a found item with a photo and description. Owners search the list or report a lost item. Staff match the two, verify the owner, and mark the item as claimed.

Why it matters. Lost items on campus sit in a box without a record. A shared list returns more items to their owners and gives staff a clear log.

Tech stack
HTMLCSSJavaScriptFirebase

Software Development [Detection System]

Jackfruit Harvest Readiness Detector

Developer

Tells a farmer if a jackfruit is ready to harvest.

How it works. A solar-powered sensor unit attaches to the tree near the fruit. It checks the fruit and reports one of three results: ready, unripe, or rotten inside.

Why it matters. A jackfruit is large and its inside is hidden. Farmers cut fruit open to find out. A wrong pick wastes the fruit. The detector reduces this waste and helps farmers choose the right harvest day.

Tech stack
PythonOpenCVTensorFlow LiteRaspberry Pi
